description:
Validate a batch of email addresses

Validates up to 25 email addresses in a single request.
Each address is checked for RFC format and DNS/MX record existence.

Cost: 1 credit(s) per call. An API key is required via the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); a per-call wallet payment via x402 is also accepted.
name: validation.email.batch
